<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
import json
def diff_summary():
    b = last_transition.before_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    c = last_transition.after_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    ch = []
    for i,(rb,rc) in enumerate(zip(b,c)):
        for j,(xb,xc) in enumerate(zip(rb,rc)):
            if xb!=xc: ch.append((i,j,xb,xc))
    return ch

probes = [
    ('A red tile (0,1)', 4, 14),
    ('A center R', 12, 14),
    ('A center W (0,1)', 10, 14),
    ('D blue tile (0,0)', 38, 38),
]
for name,r,c in probes:
    res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    changed = res.get('board_changed')
    print(name, '->', 'changed' if changed else 'no_impact', res.get('no_impact'))
    if changed:
        ch = diff_summary()
        print('  cells:', ch[:20], '... total', len(ch))
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
